summary: Diff adds a Motoko backend actor with job/firm/tracking types and initial Big 4 seeding, plus a React frontend with Internet Identity auth, routing, admin pages/guards, job details dialog with tracking controls, analytics hooks, and theme variables. Several requirements are partially evidenced, but some key spec items (notably upgrade-safe persistence and strict domain enums) are not clearly satisfied from the provided diff excerpt.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend stores data persistently across canister upgrades using stable data structures appropriate for Motoko
missing_requirements.reason: The backend snippet shows in-memory `Map.empty` structures and mutable counters, but no `stable` variables or `preupgrade`/`postupgrade` migration/persistence code is evidenced in the provided (truncated) `backend/main.mo` content.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes query methods to list open job postings with filtering by firm, category, and keyword search
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend query hook calls `actor.getAllOpenJobs()` with no filter parameters, and no backend filtered query methods are evidenced in the visible backend snippet (backend content is truncated).

hallucinated_features.description: Expanded job categories beyond the specified Accounting|Analytics (adds Audit and Tax)
hallucinated_features.reason: Spec constrains `category` to Accounting|Analytics, but backend/frontend include `#audit` and `#tax`/labels and enums.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile collection (name/email) and mandatory profile setup dialog
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not ask for user profiles; diff adds `UserProfile` types and profile CRUD plus a blocking onboarding dialog.

hallucinated_features.description: Secret-token based access-control initialization via URL parameter (`caffeineAdminToken`)
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest mentions authorized users/admin-style UI but does not specify a secret URL token bootstrap mechanism; diff adds `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret` call driven by a URL parameter.
